title: 图画作文描述与首段
desc: 通用首段工具箱：引出图画、细节描写、对比反差、图表数据与点题句，句式可直接套用。

entries.en: As is vividly depicted in the picture, ___.
entries.zh: 正如图画中生动描绘的那样，___。
entries.example: As is vividly depicted in the picture, a young man is standing at a crossroads of life.
entries.exampleZh: 正如图中生动描绘的那样，一个年轻人正站在人生的十字路口。
entries.note: 首段第一句万能开头；逗号后接完整句子，as is 不可写成 as it is。

entries.zh: 这幅漫画生动地刻画了___。
entries.example: The cartoon vividly portrays a father who is too busy with his phone to talk to his son.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅漫画生动地刻画了一位忙于看手机而无暇与儿子交谈的父亲。
entries.note: 首段点明画面主体；portrays 后接名词或名词短语，不能用 that 从句。

entries.en: As is shown in the drawing, ___.
entries.example: As is shown in the drawing, two tourists are admiring the scenery on a crowded beach.
entries.exampleZh: 如图所示，两名游客正在拥挤的海滩上欣赏风景。
entries.note: 首段开头句，与 As is vividly depicted 同义；可用被动。

entries.en: The drawing is simple yet thought-provoking.
entries.zh: 这幅画简单却发人深省。
entries.example: The drawing is simple yet thought-provoking, reminding us of the value of honest labor.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画简单却发人深省，让我们想到诚实劳动的价值。
entries.note: 首段第二句承上启下；thought-provoking 不可省略连字符。

entries.en: What the picture conveys is far-reaching.
entries.zh: 这幅画所传达的意涵十分深远。
entries.example: What the picture conveys is far-reaching and deserves our careful reflection.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画所传达的意涵十分深远，值得我们认真思考。
entries.note: 首段末句引出下文；主语从句作主语，谓语用单数 is，勿写成 are。

entries.en: The implied meaning behind the picture is that ___.
entries.example: The implied meaning behind the picture is that perseverance outweighs momentary talent.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画隐含的意思是，坚持比一时的天赋更重要。
entries.note: 置于首段收尾；that 后接完整句子，从句谓语用第三人称单数。

entries.example: As the caption reads, "Opportunities always favor those who are fully prepared."
entries.exampleZh: 正如标题所言：“机会总是垂青于有充分准备的人。”
entries.note: 首段引用图中文字；caption 可换成 subtitle，引号内首字母大写。

entries.en: The caption aptly summarizes the message of the picture.
entries.zh: 标题恰当地概括了画面的寓意。
entries.example: The caption aptly summarizes the message of the picture and arouses our deep reflection.
entries.exampleZh: 标题恰当地概括了画面的寓意，引发我们深思。
entries.note: 首段描述画面之后用；aptly 意为“恰当地”。

entries.en: Simple as the picture is, the symbolic meaning it carries is profound.
entries.zh: 尽管画面简单，但它承载的象征意义却十分深刻。
entries.example: Simple as the picture is, the symbolic meaning it carries is indeed profound.
entries.exampleZh: 不论画面多么简单，它承载的象征意义都确实深刻。
entries.note: as 引导让步状语从句需部分倒装（表语提前）；首段承转句，引出深层寓意。

entries.en: What strikes me most in the cartoon is that ___.
entries.zh: 这幅漫画中最触动我的是，___。
entries.example: What strikes me most in the cartoon is that nobody bothers to help the fallen elderly man.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅漫画中最触动我的是，没有人愿意去扶起摔倒的老人。
entries.note: 首段细节聚焦句；strikes 用第三人称单数，后可接 that 从句作表语。

entries.en: The picture presents a striking contrast between ___ and ___.
entries.zh: 这幅画呈现出___与___之间的鲜明对比。
entries.example: The picture presents a striking contrast between a hard-working student and an idle loafer.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画呈现出勤奋学生与游手好闲者之间的鲜明对比。
entries.note: 对比型图画首段核心句；between 后接并列两项。

entries.example: The former devotes himself to study, whereas the latter wastes his youth on games.
entries.exampleZh: 前者专心学习，而后者把青春浪费在游戏上。
entries.note: 对比论证用，前段分句结构须对称；whereas 前用逗号，不可与 but 连用。

entries.en: Those who ___ are in sharp contrast to those who ___.
entries.zh: 那些___的人与那些___的人形成鲜明反差。
entries.example: Those who strive for excellence are in sharp contrast to those who merely follow the herd.
entries.exampleZh: 追求卓越的人与仅仅随大流的人形成鲜明反差。
entries.note: 第二段对比论证句；those who 后接复数谓语。

entries.en: As can be seen from the chart, ___.
entries.example: As can be seen from the chart, the number of rural entrepreneurs has grown steadily.
entries.exampleZh: 从图表中可以看出，农村创业者的人数稳步增长。
entries.note: 图表作文首段开头句；the number of 后接复数名词，谓语却用单数。

entries.en: According to the figures given in the chart, ___.
entries.zh: 根据图表中给出的数据，___。
entries.example: According to the figures given in the chart, urban residents outnumber rural ones.
entries.exampleZh: 根据图表中给出的数据，城市居民的人数超过农村居民。
entries.note: 图表作文首段正式引用数据；figures 用复数。

entries.en: The proportion of ___ rose from ___ percent to ___ percent.
entries.example: The proportion of graduates choosing further study rose from forty percent to sixty percent.
entries.exampleZh: 选择继续深造的毕业生比例从四成上升到六成。
entries.note: 中间段数据句；percent 单数不加 s，谓语用单数。

entries.en: What stands out in the chart is that ___.
entries.zh: 图表中最突出的一点是，___。
entries.example: What stands out in the chart is that the consumption of fresh graduates keeps climbing.
entries.exampleZh: 图表中最突出的一点是，应届毕业生的消费持续攀升。
entries.note: 首段末句概括核心数据；keeps 用第三人称单数。

entries.en: There has been a marked increase in ___ over the past decade.
entries.zh: 过去十年间，___出现了显著增长。
entries.example: There has been a marked increase in online shopping over the past decade.
entries.exampleZh: 过去十年间，网上购物出现了显著增长。
entries.note: 与 over the past decade 连用须用现在完成时。

entries.zh: 数据本身就说明了一切：___。
entries.example: The figures speak for themselves: the gap between urban and rural incomes is narrowing.
entries.exampleZh: 数据本身就说明了一切：城乡收入差距正在缩小。
entries.note: 图表数据描述后的评论句；冒号后接完整句子，用以点明结论。

entries.en: It can be seen from the figures that ___.
entries.example: It can be seen from the figures that young people now favor rational consumption.
entries.exampleZh: 从这些数据可以看出，如今年轻人更青睐理性消费。
entries.note: it 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。

entries.en: This seemingly trivial scene mirrors a social reality.
entries.zh: 这一看似微不足道的场景折射出一个社会现实。
entries.example: This seemingly trivial scene mirrors a social reality that troubles many families.
entries.exampleZh: 这一看似微不足道的场景折射出一个困扰许多家庭的社会现实。
entries.note: 首段末尾点题句，引出第二段分析；mirrors 用第三人称单数。

entries.en: Such a phenomenon is by no means uncommon in contemporary society.
entries.zh: 这种现象在当今社会绝非罕见。
entries.example: Such a phenomenon is by no means uncommon in contemporary society.
entries.exampleZh: 这种现象在当今社会绝非罕见。
entries.note: 双重否定表强调；by no means 置于 be 之后。

entries.en: The author intends to remind us that ___.
entries.example: The author intends to remind us that genuine happiness cannot be bought with money.
entries.exampleZh: 作者意在提醒我们，真正的幸福无法用金钱买到。
entries.note: 首段末或第二段首点明寓意；remind sb. that... 后接完整从句。

entries.en: It is evident that the cartoonist is calling on us to ___.
entries.zh: 显然，漫画家在呼吁我们___。
entries.example: It is evident that the cartoonist is calling on us to cherish traditional virtues.
entries.exampleZh: 显然，漫画家在呼吁我们珍惜传统美德。
entries.note: 首段点题或尾段呼吁句；call on sb. to do sth.。

entries.en: Behind this vivid scene lies a disturbing truth: ___.
entries.zh: 在这生动场景的背后，隐藏着一个令人不安的事实：___。
entries.example: Behind this vivid scene lies a disturbing truth: indifference is spreading among us.
entries.exampleZh: 在这生动场景的背后，隐藏着一个令人不安的事实：冷漠正在我们中间蔓延。
entries.note: 完全倒装句，地点状语提前，谓语 lies 与真正主语 truth 保持一致。

entries.en: The cartoonist subtly criticizes ___ and appeals for ___.
entries.zh: 漫画家含蓄地批判了___，并呼吁___。
entries.example: The cartoonist subtly criticizes blind conformity and appeals for independent thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 漫画家含蓄地批判了盲目从众，并呼吁独立思考。
entries.note: 批判型图画首段点题句；appeal for 后接名词，不接句子。

entries.zh: 在前景中，在画面显著位置
entries.example: In the foreground stands a middle-aged man who is frantically typing on his laptop.
entries.exampleZh: 画面前景中站着一位正疯狂敲击笔记本电脑的中年男子。
entries.note: 首段画面描写用；可置于句首引起完全倒装。

entries.example: In the background, several children are playing happily on the green lawn.
entries.exampleZh: 在画面背景中，几个孩子正在绿草坪上快乐地玩耍。
entries.note: 首段由近及远描写；与 in the foreground 配对使用。

entries.example: The young man is completely absorbed in his smartphone, ignoring his parents nearby.
entries.exampleZh: 那个年轻人完全沉浸在手机里，无视身旁的父母。
entries.note: 首段描写人物状态；介词固定用 in，后接名词或动名词，不用 on。

entries.en: with one's head buried in a smartphone
entries.example: A student sits alone, with his head buried in a smartphone all the afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 一名学生独自坐着，整个下午都埋头盯着智能手机。
entries.note: 首段细节描写高频结构；with 复合结构中 buried 为过去分词表被动。

entries.example: Many teenagers are glued to the screen for hours, neglecting their homework.
entries.exampleZh: 许多青少年目不转睛地盯着屏幕数小时，忽视了作业。
entries.note: 首段描写沉迷网络类画面；介词用 to，比喻用法，比 watch 更形象。

entries.example: The jobless graduate stares blankly at the ceiling, not knowing what to do next.
entries.exampleZh: 失业的毕业生茫然地盯着天花板，不知下一步该做什么。
entries.note: 首段刻画人物心理；stare 后接 at，第三人称单数加 -es。

entries.example: Seated by the window, the girl is lost in thought about her future career.
entries.exampleZh: 女孩坐在窗边，沉浸在对未来职业的思索中。
entries.note: 首段描写静思型人物；in thought 前不加冠词。

entries.example: The volunteers wear beaming smiles as they help the elderly cross the street.
entries.exampleZh: 志愿者们面带灿烂的微笑，帮助老人过马路。
entries.note: 首段描写正面画面；smile 用复数，与 frown 对照。

entries.en: with a frown on one's face
entries.example: The anxious mother waits outside the classroom with a frown on her face.
entries.exampleZh: 焦虑的母亲眉头紧锁地在教室外等候。
entries.note: 首段描写负面情绪画面；介词用 on，frown 用单数并加冠词 a。

entries.example: The market is bustling with activity as vendors hawk their fresh vegetables.
entries.exampleZh: 市场上熙熙攘攘，摊贩们叫卖着新鲜蔬菜。
entries.note: 首段铺陈场景用；常用 be bustling with + 名词。

entries.example: The subway carriage is crowded with tired commuters heading home.
entries.exampleZh: 地铁车厢里挤满了疲惫的回家通勤者。
entries.note: 首段描写拥挤场景；介词用 with，不用 by。

entries.example: The picture unfolds before us a scene of harmony between man and nature.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画在我们面前展现出一幅人与自然和谐相处的景象。
entries.note: 首段总结画面基调；搭配 between A and B。

entries.example: The campus is bathed in warm sunlight, and students are reading on the lawn.
entries.exampleZh: 校园沐浴在温暖的阳光中，学生们在草坪上读书。
entries.note: 首段营造积极氛围；介词用 in，为下文赞扬或褒扬主题做铺垫。

entries.example: Passengers stand elbow to elbow in the packed bus during the morning rush.
entries.exampleZh: 早高峰时乘客在拥挤的公交车上摩肩接踵。
entries.note: 首段描述拥挤画面；固定结构 elbow to elbow，名词前不加冠词。

entries.example: The past decade has witnessed a steady rise in the number of rural entrepreneurs.
entries.exampleZh: 过去十年间，农村创业者的人数稳步上升。
entries.note: 图表作文首段总述趋势；witness 常以时间作主语。

entries.example: The chart shows that online courses witnessed a sharp rise after the outbreak.
entries.exampleZh: 图表显示，疫情暴发后网络课程出现了急剧增长。
entries.note: 图表作文中间段描写突变数据；sharp 强调幅度大，可与 soar 替换。

entries.example: The employment rate remained relatively stable throughout the decade under review.
entries.exampleZh: 在所述及的十年间，就业率始终保持相对稳定。
entries.note: 图表作文描述平稳段数据；后接 throughout/during + 时间段。

entries.example: The price of agricultural products fluctuated between twenty and thirty yuan.
entries.exampleZh: 农产品价格在二十到三十元之间波动。
entries.note: 图表作文描述波动数据；常用 fluctuate between A and B。

entries.example: Graduates in science and engineering account for nearly half of the total.
entries.exampleZh: 理工科毕业生几乎占到总数的一半。
entries.note: 图表作文描述占比；主语为复数时 account 不加 -s，后接百分数或比例。

entries.example: The figure peaked at sixty percent in 2020 and fell afterwards.
entries.exampleZh: 该数据在2020年达到六成的峰值，此后回落。
entries.note: 图表作文描写最高点专用；peak 作动词，后接 at + 具体数值。

entries.example: Sales bottomed out at two million units before recovering the following year.
entries.exampleZh: 销量在触底两百万件后于次年回升。
entries.note: 图表作文描写最低点；与 peak at 相对，过去式 bottomed。

entries.example: The chart reveals a threefold increase in online sales over five years.
entries.exampleZh: 图表显示，五年间网上销售额增长了三倍。
entries.note: 图表作文倍数表述；increase 后接 in + 领域。

entries.example: In stark contrast to his classmates, Tom spends every evening reading in the library.
entries.exampleZh: 与同学形成鲜明对比的是，汤姆每晚都在图书馆读书。
entries.note: 首段对比描写，置于句首作状语；介词用 to，也可用 with。

entries.example: Material comforts pale in comparison with the warmth of a harmonious family.
entries.exampleZh: 与和谐家庭的温暖相比，物质享受相形见绌。
entries.note: 第二段价值判断或尾段升华用；pale 作动词表“失色”，无被动语态。
